question: Does a CPU Place student (e5-small, linear head) answer a share of the 8-option place_region reads at 95 percent agreement with Jev, on about 1,600 queue stories with body?
one_change: train a linear head on e5-small embeddings of title plus body start against Jev place_region; answer only above a probability line fitted on a random half

baseline.model: Function student answer-when-sure, three encoders, same tolerance idea

prediction.metric: mean coverage on the held-out half at agreement with Jev of at least 0.95, 10 half-splits
prediction.why: Place is topical with strong country-name cues and Jev is 0.88 accurate vs the text judge; Function reached 0.46 to 0.57 with a binary label, eight options lower it but name cues raise it; sample is only 1,600 so the spread is wide
